faq.question: What is Vile Parle East known for?
faq.answer: Vile Parle East is known as the birthplace of the iconic Parle-G biscuit (the original Parle factory), the historic Parleshwar Temple, its strong Gujarati and Marathi community, Sathaye College, proximity to the domestic airport, and being a calm, well-settled residential suburb with great food and markets.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Vile Parle East?
faq.answer: Vile Parle East primarily uses pin code 400057, with parts of the Airport and Tejpal Scheme belt also covered under 400057 and 400099.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Vile Parle East?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Vile Parle East are Nehru Road, Hanuman Road, Mahatma Gandhi (MG) Road, Tejpal Scheme, Nanda Patkar Road, Parleshwar, Airport Colony and the Vile Parle station-east belt.

faq.question: What is the property price in Vile Parle East?
faq.answer: Property prices in Vile Parle East range from around ₹1.3–2 Cr for a 1BHK in the Nehru Road/Hanuman Road belt to ₹2.4–3.8 Cr for a 2BHK, with premium Tejpal Scheme and MG Road flats commanding higher rates. Rental rates range from ₹38,000 to ₹95,000 per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Vile Parle East?
faq.answer: Vile Parle East is served by Vile Parle Station on the Western Line (about 30 min to Churchgate), with the domestic airport (Terminal 1) just 5–10 minutes away. It also has BEST buses, easy access to the Western Express Highway and Nehru Road, and is close to Metro Line 1 (Airport Road / Marol Naka).

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Vile Parle East?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Vile Parle East include Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital, Cooper Hospital nearby, Parle Point and Hanuman Road nursing homes, and several clinics and diagnostic centres across the Nehru Road and Tejpal belt.

faq.question: Which schools and colleges are in Vile Parle East?
faq.answer: Notable institutions in Vile Parle East include Sathaye College (formerly Parle College), Parle Tilak Vidyalaya, Dr. Bhanuben Nanavati College, Mahila Sangh schools and several long-established SSC and CBSE schools.
